verdict.rationale: Factory documents `droid exec` as a headless, one-shot execution mode that completes a task and exits, built for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts and batch processing. It supports structured input and output formats, tiered autonomy for running without manual confirmation, and `--mission` for multi-agent runs. A CI code-review integration and an SDK for running the same harness from code back this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI usage.
